issues.explanation: The cited 19点 watch record leaves Vela's companion unnamed, so the draft's claim that this record establishes Sora accompanied her is unsupported.

evidence.excerpt: At 19点 Vela moved from Gate Four on the west pier to the east pier; the watch record leaves her companion unnamed.

issues.reasoning: The current claim reports the 19点 watch record as establishing that Sora accompanied Vela to the east pier. The cited record (span-6) supplies only Vela's 19点 movement from Gate Four on the west pier to the east pier and explicitly states that it leaves her companion unnamed. That omission means the record neither names Sora nor any companion, so the attribution of companionship to Sora has no warrant in the cited text; judgment stops at the missing link and the companion's identity remains unknown. Since no cited fact denies that Sora could have accompanied her, this is an unsupported attribution, not a contradiction.
